outcome: Emergency change line: record, refused, review, retrospective and report, live on the work item page
acceptance_criteria: Opening `/work/4301` in the mock shows "Preauthorisation refused", "CTO refused the preauthorisation." and the "Raise a new emergency change" link or its absence per the Start work drawer, and no authorise, record, review or retrospective control — verify: open the page; unit test on the model with a `reject` decision.
The refused board draws no refuser name, time or reason, and the track marks step 1 refused — verify: unit test asserts the section text has no name; page view.

`/work/4302` shows "Authorised by Segun Okoro · 13 Nov 08:05" from `authorization_history`, and the "Record what happened" form with proof options listing only `change_implementation` evidence — verify: page; unit test that kind `post_implementation_review` evidence is not offered.

Record outcome without `implemented_at`, or with a future date, or with a negative or fractional "Customers affected", is refused in the form and sends nothing — verify: unit test and e2e assert no POST; field messages shown.

Record outcome with both impact fields blank sends `customers_affected: null` and `side_effects: null`, not `0` or `""` — verify: unit test inspects the request body; mock `POST /work/4302/emergency` receives them.
`/work/4303` shows "Customers affected: Unknown" and "Side effects: Unknown"; `/work/4304` shows "0" and "None found" — verify: page; unit test for `customers_affected: 0` renders "0" not "Unknown".
The review board has exactly one decision button, "Confirm outcome", and no "Return with a note" or return control — verify: page; test asserts the label list.

"Confirm outcome" sends `action:"record_review"` with `evidence_id` of kind `post_implementation_review`, a non-empty `note`, and the tokens from the read; with no matching evidence the button is disabled and says "No proof is available yet." — verify: unit test on the body; page.

"Accept as handled" sends `retrospective_decision` verdict `approve`; "Needs follow-up work" sends `return`; the role field offers only `Product` and `Engineering Lead`; `reject` is never sent from this form — verify: unit tests on the body for both.

The follow-up form appears only when the followups read has `can_manage: true`; it sends `action:"create"` with `category` `Normal` or `Standard` and the followups read's `revision`; on `can_manage:false` or a 403 it is absent — verify: page against `4304` and `4308`; unit test on the body.

`/work/4305` shows the report as drafted with "Not reviewed yet" and "No receipt yet"; `/work/4306` shows "Approved", "2 delivery receipts recorded" and "The emergency is closed"; "closed" does not appear on `4305` — verify: page.

The report review sends `POST /work/{id}/reviews` with `kind:"document"`, `version_id` equal to `document_version_id`, the tokens and a verdict; "Return report" and "Refuse report" without a note send nothing — verify: unit test on the body; e2e.

A control appears only for an action in `actions[]`: a read with `actions:[]` draws no write control; `4307` draws "Authorise the change" and it asks for confirmation before sending — verify: unit test over the six actions; page.
A 409 on any write keeps the typed text, re-reads, shows "This changed while you were working. Check it and press again." and does not resend — verify: mock `4309`; unit test counts requests.
A 403 `csrf_failed` is not shown as "no access"; a 403 on the report review shows "You can't review this report." — verify: unit test with mocked client.

While a write is in flight its button is disabled and a second press sends nothing; after a network failure the panel is re-read before Try again is offered — verify: unit test with a deferred promise; request count.

A write is not reported as saved until the re-read shows it: after 201 with an unchanged read the page says it could not confirm the change and offers a re-read — verify: unit test with a mock that answers 201 but an unchanged GET.
`critical_production: null` shows "Not classified", never "No" — verify: unit test.
A work id the account cannot see answers 404 and the page shows exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: open a live id the account cannot see and a mock 404; compare text.
An unknown `stage` value shows its raw text and no track; unknown `actions[]` entries draw nothing — verify: unit test.

The adapter is registered with `registerLineAdapter` under `emergency`, `commands()` descriptors use `POST /api/v1/work/{id}/emergency`, carry `profile_id`, and never put `0` for a null token — verify: `frontend/src/features/emergency/emergencyAdapter.test.ts`.

Against live Django (8020, account with an emergency work item) the page matches `oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{id}/emergency` for stage, decisions, history names and times, and impact — verify: compare page with the viewer output.
No new "not available" placeholders are drawn for data the read does not carry (decision names, notes, `implemented_at`, recipients) — verify: grep the sections for those words; page.

The fidelity review compares the desktop and mobile boards `SCR-50-*-refused/record/review/retro/report` with the page and every difference is on the Conflicts list below or is fixed — verify: design fidelity tool output for the five states.

risk.rationale: High because the line records authorisations and outcomes for emergency production changes. Showing null customers affected as zero, or misreading reject as return, would misstate a business record. Surfaces: ui, api and contract-change for the new reads and commands; auth for the role-gated decisions; product-decision because the flow is new to the client. Sources: architecture/packages/v9/tasks.csv and delivery/connect/screens-d-delivery-issues-escalation.md.
